source._comment: NM SoS Voter Turnout portal shows early/absentee turnout by county and party. It is an ASPX dashboard (no confirmed flat file off-season). CHECKED 2026-10-07: the old electionresults.sos.nm.gov domain now redirects to the generic sos.nm.gov site; the real portal (linked from that redirect page) is electionresults.sos.state.nm.us. Could not reach that domain this run (this runner's egress proxy rejects the CONNECT to electionresults.sos.state.nm.us with a 502 -- unverified, not confirmed down). Staged skeleton: reads 0 until the live data endpoint is confirmed reachable and parsed. NM early voting opens ~Oct 7.
